features.feature: Authority Server retirement replaces active CLI vocabulary with admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, evidenceScope, local gate-consumed evidence, local signed/offline bundle evidence, and local review quorum.
Authority production receipts, productionDone, authorityDone, and fullAuthorityDone must not be presented as local CLI completion states.
User-facing docs and host prompts stop warning that local evidence is non-authority unless an Authority Server receipt exists and instead explain local admissibility.
Server-backed authority command and alias surface is removed while local proof, admissibility, and quorum commands remain.
Server-backed Authority handlers, core modules, tasks, env URL/mode paths, and receipt paths are removed or quarantined while receipt-bundle, proof-admissibility, and quorum behavior remain.
Regression guard fails if active docs, prompts, command catalog, aliases, config, or registry reintroduce Authority Server product semantics outside a legacy or retirement allowlist.
Build, targeted smokes, lattice validate, and CLI patch version bump prove the cleanup before DONE.

Authority live integration decision doc active authority mode job loop, native gate_decision receipt verification, authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone final JSON, and LATTICE_AUTHORITY runtime expectations must be retired/legacy/out-of-core rather than active implementation guidance.

Authority customer API key decision doc LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL, project/server key, customer API key, actor key, runner/session env, and production mutating API authorization must be retired/legacy/out-of-core rather than active implementation guidance.

Authority receipt contract and receipt-gate execution docs server-signed gate_decision receipts as lifecycle gate or authorityDone inputs must be retired/legacy/out-of-core rather than active implementation guidance.

CLI Authority client receipt-ref decision doc authority_status and authority_receipt_verify production receipt/ref surfaces including productionDone language must be retired/legacy/out-of-core rather than active implementation guidance.

Authority runner session and evidence envelope doc Authority URL, actor key, runner id/session id, and Authority Server evidence submission path must be retired/legacy/out-of-core rather than active implementation guidance.

Generated/live E2E Authority plans authority job create/status/verdict paths and authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone target states must be retired/legacy/out-of-core rather than active implementation guidance.
